query: Can you audit the SEO on our whole site before the redesign launches?
check the SEO on our blog, especially the hreflang setup for the en and ru versions
check whether our titles, meta descriptions and structured data are still healthy across the site
we shipped a new deploy last night, can you confirm nothing that ranking depends on quietly broke, robots.txt, canonicals, that kind of thing
we have three thousand auto-generated /city/service pages, I'm worried Google sees them as duplicate junk
go check whether ChatGPT and other AI answer engines can actually crawl and cite our docs pages
check whether search engines can even find our pages, maybe something in robots.txt is blocking the crawl
compare how the page looks in the raw HTML versus what actually renders in the browser, I think something's hidden from crawlers
check our structured data and how the page will show up in search results
our local landing pages for each city, do they have the business info Google needs to show them in local results
check whether this page is usable with a screen reader before we ship it
why isn't this page converting, does the CTA structure need fixing
check whether our JSON-LD matches the prices we actually charge
why is our LCP so bad on mobile for the pricing page
write a keyword-rich meta description for this new landing page
review this PR that changes our robots.txt and sitemap generator before merge
what's the practical difference between a 301 and a 302 redirect
just add a canonical tag to this one page, one line change
what are breadcrumbs on a site, what are they even for
